items.text: Prompt... .... video 📷 CINEMATIC VIDEO PROMPT — SEOUL Create an ultra-realistic cinematic aerial travel film of Seoul, South Korea, designed as a premium tourism commercial. The scene opens with a breathtaking wide establishing shot of Seoul at golden hour, showing the massive city skyline, Han River, modern skyscrapers, surrounding mountains, bridges, highways, and realistic traffic moving naturally through the city. The camera begins high above the city with a slow, smooth cinematic drone movement, gradually flying forward while gently descending toward the skyline. The sunlight is warm and soft, creating beautiful golden reflections across the glass buildings and river. Atmospheric haze creates realistic depth between the foreground buildings, distant mountains, and skyline. As the camera moves closer, reveal N Seoul Tower standing prominently on Namsan Mountain, surrounded by lush green trees. The camera performs a slow, elegant cinematic orbit around the tower, keeping it as the main focal point while the enormous Seoul skyline stretches across the background. Transition naturally from golden hour into sunset. The sky develops beautiful warm orange, pink, and subtle purple tones while the city gradually begins to illuminate. Building windows, streetlights, bridges, and vehicles start glowing one by one. Continue the camera movement smoothly toward the city, transitioning into blue hour and early nighttime. Seoul becomes filled with thousands of realistic lights. Show flowing traffic on illuminated roads, reflections of city lights on the Han River, glowing skyscrapers, and N Seoul Tower beautifully illuminated above the city. End with a spectacular high-altitude wide aerial shot, slowly pulling backward and upward to reveal the enormous scale of Seoul at night, with the river, bridges, mountains, skyline, and N Seoul Tower all visible in one breathtaking composition. CAMERA & MOTION - Professional cinematic drone camera - Slow forward aerial flight - Gradual controlled descent - Smooth cinematic push-in - Gentle orbit around N Seoul Tower - Natural camera acceleration and deceleration - Final slow pull-back and upward reveal - No sudden movements - No shaky footage - No unnatural camera transitions - Realistic aerial parallax and depth VISUAL STYLE Ultra-photorealistic, premium travel documentary, cinematic tourism commercial, realistic Korean architecture, highly detailed skyscrapers, natural vegetation, realistic roads and vehicles, realistic atmospheric perspective, subtle volumetric light, detailed reflections, physically accurate lighting, realistic shadows, natural depth of field. LIGHTING Golden-hour sunlight → dramatic sunset → soft blue hour → vibrant Seoul night lights. Warm sunlight should naturally illuminate the buildings and river before gradually fading into a sophisticated nighttime city atmosphere. VIDEO SETTINGS Aspect Ratio: 9:16 vertical Resolution: 4K Frame Rate: 24fps cinematic Lens: 24mm wide-angle aerial lens Depth of Field: Natural cinematic depth Motion Blur: Subtle realistic motion blur Camera Stability: Extremely smooth professional drone footage Color Grade: Premium cinematic travel-film grading Quality: Ultra-detailed photorealism NEGATIVE PROMPT No cartoon look, no CGI appearance, no distorted buildings, no warped skyline, no flickering lights, no duplicated objects, no unnatural traffic, no shaky camera, no excessive motion blur, no artificial-looking sky, no oversaturated colors, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no people close to camera, no facial distortions.

items.text: Tool:Gemini AI Prompt inspired by @KrevixAi ⬇️ Use the uploaded visual storyboard reference. Follow its shot progression, timing, camera angles, composition and action. Do NOT reproduce the storyboard panels, borders, grid, collage or multiple images in the final video. The output must be one continuous full-frame 16:9 cinematic commercial. Create a seamless 10-second ultra-realistic luxury food commercial featuring the double-decker cheeseburger shown in @Image1. 0:00–0:01.5 Start with the complete double-decker cheeseburger exactly as shown in @Image1. Keep it centered against the black background. Hold briefly, then separate the existing burger layers vertically in perfect alignment: top bun, sauce, lettuce, tomato, cheese, upper beef patty, cheese, lower beef patty, onions, sauce, bottom bun. Cheese stretches naturally. A few crumbs and sesame seeds float. Steam rises. Slow cinematic push-in. 0:01.5–0:02.5 Everything freezes in mid-air. Cheese remains stretched, steam barely moves and tiny particles drift. Camera smoothly orbits around the suspended burger, creating elegant parallax. Keep every ingredient aligned and recognizable. 0:02.5–0:03.5 Time suddenly resumes. All layers accelerate downward and perfectly reassemble into the original double-decker burger. Cheese stretches and settles naturally. At impact, create a subtle burst of crumbs, steam and sesame movement. Fast cinematic push-in. 0:03.5–0:04.2 Two realistic masculine hands quickly enter from below, grab the burger and pull it straight downward out of frame. Fast movement with natural motion blur. Smash cut. 0:04.2–0:07.0 Fast premium burger-making montage. Beef hits a hot grill. Spatula smashes the beef. Browned crust forms. Cheese melts over the patty. Second patty grills. Sauce spreads over toasted bun. Lettuce and tomato drop into place. First patty lands. Second patty lands. Cheese melts. Top bun closes. Use only strong, readable actions. Fast motivated match cuts, macro close-ups, low grill angle, overhead shot, short push-ins and whip-pan transitions. Every transition follows the physical movement of the food. 0:07.0–0:08.6 Finished double-decker cheeseburger rises into the black background. Golden toasted sesame bun, two juicy beef patties, molten cheese, fresh vegetables and glossy sauce. Steam rises naturally. Slow elegant three-quarter orbit. Show crisp beef edges, melted cheese, sauce and sesame detail. 0:08.6–0:10.0 Masculine hands lift the burger. A masculine mouth enters frame and takes one powerful bite. Bun compresses naturally. Long realistic cheese pull. Steam escapes. Subtle handheld macro movement. Hold briefly on the cheese pull. Cut to pure black. No logo. No generated branding. No text. CAMERA: Luxury food-commercial cinematography. 50mm hero lens, 100mm macro lens, low grill angles, overhead preparation shots, controlled orbital movement, cinematic push-ins, short whip pans, macro tracking, natural shallow depth of field and realistic motion blur. Camera movement must always be motivated by the food action. LIGHTING: Deep black hero background, warm premium restaurant lighting, soft directional key light, controlled rim light, golden highlights on the bun and cheese, realistic shadows and subtle illumination through steam. No neon and no artificial sci-fi lighting. AUDIO: Fast premium food-commercial music around 100 BPM, no vocals. Crisp percussion, restrained bass and cinematic tension. Synchronize strong beats with ingredient separation, reassembly, grill impact, cheese melt, hero reveal and bite. Include realistic sizzling, spatula impact, steam, food movement and satisfying bite crunch. REALISM: Physically believable food physics. Realistic cheese elasticity, sauce viscosity, steam, crumbs, beef deformation and bun compression. Preserve the burger's identity and appearance consistently.
